summary: Solve 78 picture and pattern puzzles, or make your own from photos.
page_description: Pan larger grids, inspect full clues and keep your marks and undo history when reopening.
release_notes: Rebuilt with the current Cobalt SDK.

steps.text: The bundled puzzles play straight away. To make one from a photo:
Set up the reader once over USB, if you have not already.
Turn a photo into a puzzle and send it. It appears under Photos, beside the ones sent before.
